summary: Stocks are higher across the board this afternoon, with the Dow up about 1% and tech recovering as oil prices fall. The VIX is down nearly 4%, a sign of easing anxiety into the close.
market_note: Indexes holding gains late in the session; Dow futures up 1.01% and VIX at 14.83.

items.why: AWS growth accelerated to 37% and management raised 2026 capex to about $220 billion, backing the AI buildout. Buyers are piling in ahead of Q3 earnings on Oct 29.

Microsoft is closing in on a $4 trillion market cap for the first time in nearly a year. Investors are renewing optimism on cloud growth and returns from its AI spending, with the stock up over 50% from its June low.

Tesla registered a record 150 additional Cybercabs in Texas, nearly doubling its fleet, and Musk is asserting control over the Terafab chip project. Tigress also reiterated a Buy rating with a $550 target.
CEO Lisa Su shared supply news with investors today, per Yahoo Finance, weighing on the stock while the broader tech tape recovers.
